basic_info.description: Lovely two-bedroom, one-bath condominium located right across from the Presidio Library garden and on a designated Slow Street'! This classic residence is a tranquil retreat from the city with treetop outlooks from both bedrooms and charming period details including hardwood flooring, etched glass windows in the living/dining room, and bay windows. A gracious entry with a storage closet leads to an inviting living room with a separate dining area. Adjacent is a beautiful chef's kitchen, equipped with marble countertops, tile backsplash, and stainless appliances including a gas range. There is a wonderful eat-in breakfast area in front of a greenhouse window. The generous primary bedroom is furnished with a walk-in closet, and the expansive second bedroom or den has a built-in window seat to admire the tree-lined street below, and a large walk-in closet ensuite which could be used as a great home office (as other units in the building have done). An attractive bath off the hallway is outfitted with a shower over a tub. This boutique building with an elegant lobby, complete with marble floor and gilded moldings, offers shared laundry and private storage. Conveniently located near chic Sacramento Street boutiques, dining and cafes, the Presidio, public transit, and more.
